question: Can the v15 changed behavior be reconstructed by a small selective cross-boundary circuit made from the four causally material heads and the other complete modules with absolute singleton behavior at least .10?
novelty: Prior work contains greedy module and head programs on earlier temporal constructions, but no executed adaptive combination on the v15 changed graph and no combination that replaces live attention modules 8/9/11 by their prospectively localized complete heads.

population.sealed_confirmation: The 16 A2 Currently/Previously target rows; these outcomes do not select the sequence or stopping prefix.
population.selectivity_controls: All 16 P same-answer temporal-paraphrase rows and all 16 C canonical same-answer controls. Controls constrain selection but never contribute positive target reward.

candidate_rule.derivation: Heads are exactly those with absolute standalone behavior >=.10 and direction >=.75 in the frozen head atlas. Other modules are exactly the non-attention-8/9/11 module singletons with absolute behavior >=.10 in the frozen module atlas. MLP17 is retained despite its negative sign so the rule is symmetric and prospective.

intervention: At every chosen component, replace the complete aligned base response through the semantic query position by its paired donor response. A head replaces its native 128-dimensional pre-c_proj slice; an attention module replaces all nine such slices; an MLP replaces its complete 1152-dimensional output. Multiple hooks execute together through the native suffix.

adaptive_greedy.algorithm: Starting from the empty set, evaluate every one-component extension of the current set. Choose the extension with largest A1 behavioral signed projection among arms with zero P/C top-one flips and pooled P/C median centered full-vocabulary KL <=.05. If no extension is selective, choose the largest A1 projection and record a selectivity fallback. Break exact ties by the frozen candidate order above. Continue through all 17 components so the full sequence and every marginal are observed.
adaptive_greedy.selected_prefix: The earliest sequence prefix with A1 behavioral signed projection >=.80, A1 direction fraction >=.875, zero P/C top-one flips, and pooled P/C median centered KL <=.05. No A2 quantity participates.
adaptive_greedy.necessity: For each of the 17 frozen candidate names, execute the selected prefix with that name excluded. Selected names are genuine leave-one-component-out arms; exclusions of nonselected names must replay the selected prefix and are exact no-op controls. A selected component is materially necessary when removal lowers A1 signed projection by >=.05 or makes the prefix fail its A1/selectivity eligibility.

predictions.pred_a_authority_population_closure_fini: All authority hashes, row counts/order, candidate derivations, and aligned shapes match; empty/base-self errors are <=1e-4; all reports are finite; exactly 174 forwards execute.
predictions.pred_b_discovery_selective_prefix_exists: An A1-selected prefix reaches >=.80 behavioral projection, >=.875 direction, zero P/C top-one flips, and pooled P/C median centered KL <=.05.
predictions.pred_c_selected_prefix_confirms_without_: The A1-selected prefix reaches A2 behavioral projection >=.75 and direction >=.875 without using A2 in selection.
predictions.pred_d_selected_program_is_smaller_than_: The selected eligible prefix uses at most 10 of 17 candidates.
predictions.pred_e_selected_program_has_multiple_nec: At least two selected components are materially necessary by the frozen leave-one-out rule.
predictions.pred_f_response_operator_agrees_with_beh: The selected prefix has full-final-residual signed projection >=.50 on both A1 and A2; failure is retained as evidence that even the full residual is an incomplete proxy for behavior.

terminal_policy.confirmation_failure: A and B pass but C fails.
terminal_policy.no_small_selective_prefix: A passes and B or D fails.
terminal_policy.partial: A passes and no more specific terminal applies.

next_branch: If a selective prefix confirms, freeze it and test a new lexical/construction bank plus task-pair composition. If no selective prefix exists, use control-conditioned pruning or within-MLP splitting rather than adding more complete modules.
